body:
Vintage card, your reference look (31 Oct).
1. 🐾 My pets: a paper strip under the pet list: 🪪 ANIMAL LICENSE · Level 1 ★☆☆ ›. Tap: the card.
2. Card: name, level stars, next level (🏆 Pet Show top 3, 🥇 1st for level 3, 💚 healthy weeks), animals you can have.
3. Shield shows your first pet. Stamp: Certified, valid forever. Gold Top level stamp at 3. No stamp before level 1.
4. The same card pops up when Sir Barkley hands you a new level.
5. The card stays paper-coloured in dark mode.
Build note: 2 Google fonts added (Alfa Slab One, Roboto Slab).
